body:
## Expected Behavior
Running `make unit-test` and/or `make integration-test` and/or `make functional-test` should complete without `FAIL`.

## Actual Behavior
Any and all of the above tests have at least one failed test and complete with status `FAIL`.

Is that expected and acceptable or should all tests pass? If this is not normal, is this an anomaly in my local environment only and what can I do to correct the situation?

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem

  1. run `make start-depenencies` - all containers started successfully.
  1. run `make test` or any of the specific tests
  1. observe that the test run complete with status `FAIL`

## Specifications

  - Version: main branch
  - Platform: Mac OSX ARM64

comments.body:
@uromahn we are aware that there are some flaky tests that we are trying to improve. We do run these tests in CI for each commit and they all usually pass.
Could you please some additional details.
1. Are the failures consistent?
2. If so, which tests fail consistently.

title: QUESTION: multiple unit, integration, and functional tests failing
